senses.gloss: उद्-√ भञ्ज् See forms below.
उद्-भग्न mfn. burst, torn, Suśr.
उद्-भङ्ग m. the act of breaking off, leaving off.
उद्भट mfn. excellent, eminent, exalted, magnanimous, extraordinary, Bhar.; Viddh.
vehement, passionate, Gīt.
उद्भट m. a tortoise, L.
a fan for winnowing corn, L.
N. of an author.
उद्भट—त्व n. weight, importance (of a contradiction), Sarvad.
उद्-√ भर्त्स् P. (impf. 2. pl.? -अभर्त्सत, ŚāṅkhŚr. xii, 23, 1; -अभर्त्सथ? AV. xx, 134, 1[MSS.]) to use roughly?
उद्-भव See उद्-√ भू.
उद्-भव m. existence, generation, origin, production, birth
springing from, growing
becoming visible, Yājñ.; Mn.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.
birth-place, ŚvetUp.; Kāvyād.
N. of a son of Nahuṣa, VP.
a sort of salt, L., (ifc.) mfn. produced or coming from, MBh.; Mn. &c.
उद्-भाव m. production, generation g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136
rising (of sounds), Puṣpas. ix, 4, 22.
उद्भस m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.
उद्-भास m. radiance, splendour g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136 (not in the Kāś.)
उद्-√ भा P. -भाति, to become visible, appear, Mn.; BhP.
उद्-भास—वत् mfn. shining, radiant, ib.
उद्-भासित mfn. come forth, appeared
lighted up, illuminated, splendid
ornamented, graced, beautiful.
उद्भासिन् mfn. shining, radiant, Kum.; Bhartṛ.
coming forth, appearing, Rājat.; Daśar.
giving or causing splendour, Mṛcch.
उद्-भासुर mfn. shining, radiant, Amar.
2. उद्-भि॑द् mfn. penetrating, bursting through
coming or bursting forth, pouring, overflowing
abounding with, RV.; AV. v, 20, 11; VS.
breaking forth (from the earth), sprouting, germinating, MBh.
उद्-भि॑द् (त्), m. a kind of sacrifice, KātyŚr.; ĀśvŚr. &c.
उद्-भि॑द् (त्), f. a sprout or shoot of a plant, a plant
a spring, fountain, Suśr.
(with इन्द्रस्य) N. of a Sāman.
उद्-भिज् (in comp. for 2. उद्-भि॑द् below).
उद्-भिज्—ज mfn. sprouting, germinating (as a plant), ChUp.; AitUp.; MBh.; Mn. &c.
उद्-भि॑द्—विद्या f. the science of plants, botany.
उद्-भिद mfn. sprouting, germinating, MBh.
उद्-भिद m. N. of a son of Jyotiṣmat
of the Varṣa ruled over by him, VP.
उद्-भिद n. a fountain, spring, L.
a kind of salt, L.
N. of a Sāman.
उ॑द्-भिन्न mfn. burst forth, opened, burst
having broken through, come forth, appeared
made to appear, brought to light, Kull.
appearing above, AV. x, 5, 36; xvi, 8, 1 seqq.; Mālav.; Pañcat. &c.
discovered, betrayed, Sāh.
provided or abounding with, BhP.; Pañcat.
उद्-भेद m. the act of breaking through or out, becoming manifest or visible, appearing, sprouting, Śak. 85 d; Kum.; Bhartṛ.; Sāh. &c.
(in dram.) the first manifestation of the germ (बीज) of the plot, Sāh.; Daśar.; Pratāpar.
a sprout or shoot of a plant, L.
a spring, fountain, R.; MBh.
treachery, Kathās.
mentioning, Prasannar.
उद्-भेदन n. the act of breaking through or out, coming forth, MBh.; Car.
उद्-भुज mfn. with uplifted arms, Dharmaś.
2. उद्-भू mf(भ्वी॑)n(भु॑). ‘being up to what is wanted’, sufficient
having persistency, persevering, AV. ix, 2, 16; xviii, 4, 26; VS. xv, 1.
उद्-भव—कर mfn. productive.
उद्-भव-कोशक m. the womb, MārkP.
उद्-भव—क्षेत्र n. the place of origin, Daś.
उद्-भावन n. the act of raising up, elevation, MBh. xiii, 2913; Lalit.
passing over, inattention, neglect, disregard, MBh.
announcement, communication, Naiṣ.
making visible, manifestation, Kāraṇḍ.
उद्-भावयितृ mfn. one who raises upwards or elevates, Daś.
उद्-भावित mfn. caused to exist, created, produced, Sāh.
उद्भाविन् mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 136) coming forth, becoming visible &c.
उद्-भूत mfn. come forth, produced, born
grown, MaitrUp.; MBh.; R.; Kathās. &c.
raised, elevated, increased, R.; Ṛtus.
visible, perceptible, distinct, positive, Bhāṣāp.
उद्-भूत—त्व n. the state of being increased, MaitrUp. v, 2.
उद्-भूत—रूप n. visible form or shape
उद्-भूत—रूप mfn. having a visible shape.
उद्-भूत—स्पर्श-वत् mfn. having distinct or positive tangibility, tangible, Bhāṣāp. 55.
उद्-भूति f. coming forth, existence, appearance, Kap.
elevation, increase, Kum.; Vikr.
उद्-भ्यस॑ (√ भ्यस् connected with √ भी), trembling, AV. xi, 9, 17.
उद्-भ्रम m. whirling
excitement, L.
intoxication, L.
N. of a class of beings attending on Śiva, SkandaP.
उद्-भ्रमण n. the act of moving or whirling upwards, rising, ascending Comm. on Śak. 263, 1.
उद्-भ्रान्त mfn. risen, ascended, gone or jumped up, turned upwards, MBh.; R.; Ragh.; Pañcat. &c.
come forth or out of (the earth), Kathās.
run away, disappeared, Rājat.
wandering about, roaming, MBh.
agitated, excited, bewildered, distressed, MBh.; R.; VarBṛS. &c.
whirled, flourished
waved (as a sword)
उद्-भ्रान्त n. the act of waving (a sword), MBh.
the rising (of the wind), Hariv.
excitement, agitation, Sāh.
उद्भ्रान्तक mfn. wandering about, roaming, NṛsUp.
उद्भ्रान्तक n. whirling upwards, rising, ascending, Śak. 263, 1.
उद्-भ्रू mfn. having the brows drawn up, Bālar. 36, 1.
